# BitterGit

> BitterGit is an open-source, self-hosted Git service for AI coding agents. An
> app can start with ordinary Git without requiring a GitHub account first.

## Public Pages

- [BitterGit website](https://bittergit.com/)
- [Markdown mirror](https://bittergit.com/index.md)
- [Full BitterGit public context](https://bittergit.com/llms-full.txt)

- [Quick start](https://github.com/sheetgenius/bittergit#quick-start)
- [Experience BitterGit in Bitter](https://bitter.sh/)

## Boundary

The open-source service repository owns the Git server and source-custody
implementation. The website repository owns bittergit.com, Markdown mirrors,
crawler files, smoke tests, and deployment-boundary documentation. The public
website is not the Git remote or product API endpoint.
